name: lead-quality-closed-out-of-area
about: LR4: one campaign's leads are mostly closed as out of area — the reason a recruiter gave, per campaign, which no other part of the sheet can show. The other campaign has no such close.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, 2 campaigns spent $284.25 for 7 leads at $40.61 per lead, with a 1.4% click rate.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet brought 6 leads on $184.50, at $30.75 per lead and a 1.5% click rate. Dedicated night runs brought 1 lead on $99.75, so its cost per lead was $99.75, with a 1.1% click rate.

Out of area stands out for Regional Class A — Joliet: over the last 14 days, 11 of its 24 leads were closed as out of area. In the same window, 3 missed a hard requirement (12.5% of its leads), and 2 were wrong numbers (10.5% of those called).

Over the last 14 days, Dedicated night runs had 1 wrong number among 8 leads called (12.5% of those called), and 1 of its 9 leads missed a hard requirement (11.1% of its leads). Its median time to a first call was 42 minutes, compared with 11 for Regional Class A — Joliet.

Of the mature cohorts, the week of 2026-09-28 did better than the week of 2026-09-21. It had 40 leads with 20 converted (50.0%) and 5 hired (12.5%), against 38 leads with 17 converted (44.7%) and 4 hired (10.5%).
The week of 2026-10-26 is too young to judge. So far it has 12 leads, with 9 contacted, 3 made applicants and 1 applied, and none hired yet.
Meta spend for November 2026 is $612.30 so far, with 28 days left in the month.
